projection.node_unit: elaborated proposition binding; theorem-value telescope preferred, target InfoTree fallback
projection.edge_unit: metavariable-free proof value checked by Lean's kernel in its local context

policies.universal_introduction: fixed at graph boundary; not an edge
policies.binding_identity: Lean FVarId within the theorem-value telescope
policies.duplicate_propositions: distinct binders remain distinct even when propositions print identically
policies.side_conditions: retained and tagged; excluded from main-only metrics
policies.retrieval: declaration-name overlay; search events are not reasoning nodes
policies.incomplete_info_tree_snapshot: audited and excluded; never emitted as a verified edge

provenance.proof_fragment: have hA : 0 < (a : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast ha
have hC : (c : ℝ) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
have hsumR : (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) + (c : ℝ) < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hsum

have hlamgt : 1 < lam :=
    quadratic_root_gt_one hA hC hsumR hlampos hlamroot

have hmurootR :
      (a : ℝ) * mu ^ 2 + (-2 * (a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) * mu +
        ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) + (c : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    push_cast at hmuroot
    convert hmuroot using 1 <;> ring_nf

have hmu_at_one :
      (a : ℝ) + (-2 * (a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) +
        ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) + (c : ℝ)) < 0 := by
    have : (a : ℝ) + (-2 * (a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) +
        ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) + (c : ℝ)) = (c : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact hC

have hmu_gt : 1 < mu :=
    quadratic_root_gt_one hA hsumR hmu_at_one hmupos hmurootR

have hrel : 1 - (c : ℝ) / ((a : ℝ) * lam) = mu :=
    transformed_root_relation hA hC hlampos hlamroot hmuunique'
have hAne : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA
have hlamne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlampos
have hCne : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hC
have hsumne : (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) + (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hsumR

have hcdiv : (c : ℝ) / ((a : ℝ) * lam) = -((b : ℝ) / (a : ℝ)) - lam := by
    field_simp [hAne,hlamne]
    nlinarith [hlamroot]

have hmlin : mu = lam + 1 + (b : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) := by
    linarith [hrel,hcdiv]
have hVlam := quadratic_volume_eq hA hC hsumR hlampos hlamgt hlamroot
have hVmu := quadratic_volume_eq hA hsumR hmu_at_one hmupos hmu_gt hmurootR

have hfmu : (a : ℝ) + (-2 * (a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) +
      ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) + (c : ℝ)) = (c : ℝ) := by ring
  rw [hfmu] at hVmu
have hquad := quadratic_sum_from_relation hAne hlamroot hmlin
have hrC := rational_c_sum_from_relation hAne hCne hmlin

have hrD := rational_d_sum_from_relation hAne hsumne hmlin
  rw [hVlam, hVmu]
